text: Start with Mum. Mum feeds the kitten and keeps it safe. What does Mum do for the kitten?
Mum takes care of the kitten.
What does Dad do when he feeds the puppy and keeps it safe?
Dad takes care of the puppy.
Start with We. We feed the rabbits and keep them safe. What do we do for the rabbits?
We take care of the rabbits.
Start with Nina. Nina feeds the bird and keeps it safe. What does she do for the bird?
Nina takes care of the bird.
Start with Tom. Tom feeds the dog and keeps it safe. What does he do for the dog?
Tom takes care of the dog.
Start with We. You and a friend feed the kittens and keep them safe. What do you do for them?
We take care of the kittens.
Mum feeds a kitten and keeps it safe. What does Mum do?
Mum takes care of the kitten.
Now Mum and Dad help the kitten together. Build the new sentence.
They take care of the kitten.
Dad feeds a puppy and keeps it safe. Fix one word.
Dad takes care of the puppy.
What does the kitten do when it sleeps for ten minutes?
The kitten takes a nap.
Start with The. These tiger cubs sleep for five minutes. What do the cubs do?
The cubs take a nap.
Start with The. This puppy sleeps for fifteen minutes. What does the puppy do?
The puppy takes a nap.
Say a full sentence. This orangutan sleeps for ten minutes. What does it do?
The orangutan takes a nap.
Say a full sentence. These kittens sleep for five minutes. What do they do?
The kittens take a nap.
Say a full sentence. This tiger sleeps for fifteen minutes. What does it do?
The tiger takes a nap.
A puppy sleeps for ten minutes. What does it do?
The puppy takes a nap.
Now two puppies sleep for ten minutes. Build the new sentence.
The puppies take a nap.
Two kittens sleep for five minutes. Fix one word.
The kittens take a nap.
Start with The. One orangutan. Its home is the forest. Where does it live?
The orangutan lives in the forest.
Start with The. Two tigers. Their home is a reserve. Where do they live?
The tigers live in a reserve.
Start with The. One baby orangutan. Its home is the rainforest. Where does it live?
The baby orangutan lives in the rainforest.
Say a full sentence. One lion. Its home is a reserve. Where does it live?
The lion lives in a reserve.
Say a full sentence. Two orangutans. Their home is the rainforest. Where do they live?
The orangutans live in the rainforest.
Say a full sentence. Two lions. Their home is the forest. Where do they live?
The lions live in the forest.
One tiger has a home in the forest. Where does it live?
The tiger lives in the forest.
Now two tigers have a home in a reserve. Build the new sentence.
The tigers live in a reserve.
Two orangutans have a home in the rainforest. Fix one word.
The orangutans live in the rainforest.
Name both characters. Nina rolls a ball to a kitten. They play. Who are the two characters?
Nina and the kitten are characters.
Name both characters. Leo gives a bowl to a puppy. They sit together. Who are the two characters?
Leo and the puppy are characters.
Name both characters. Ava opens a box. A rabbit jumps in. Who are the two characters?
Ava and the rabbit are characters.
Name both characters. Max holds a stick. A dog runs to him. Who are the two characters?
The characters are Max and the dog.
Name both characters. Lily puts a basket down. A cat jumps in. Who are the two characters?
The characters are Lily and the cat.
Name both characters. Sam puts a cup beside a bird. The bird sings. Who are the two characters?
The characters are Sam and the bird.
Nina rolls a ball to a kitten. Name both characters.
Nina and the kitten are characters.
In a new story, a kitten sleeps on a mat. Name the character.
The kitten is a character.
Leo gives a ball to a puppy. Fix one word.
Leo and the puppy are characters.
